open_points.subject: A13 Required test 13
open_points.text: a submission in a valid owner session, with the session's CSRF value and inputs valid for that action, that omits only the confirmation value is refused; the action is not performed and the log holds no entry of it
open_points.question: When a valid pending confirmation exists, does a submission that omits its confirmation value leave that pending value available or use it up?
options: Leave the pending confirmation unchanged, because rule 6 says it is used up only by a submission that carries an equal value.
Clear the pending confirmation, treating the omitted value like any refused confirmation attempt that requires the step to be shown again.
open_points.default_guess: Leave the pending confirmation unchanged, matching rule 6's explicit definition of when a submission carries and uses up the value.

witness.initial: A valid owner session has a still-valid pending confirmation bound to an archive action and its current inputs.
events: The owner submits those valid inputs and CSRF value but omits only the confirmation value.
The owner resubmits the same action with the previously shown confirmation value.
outcomes: The first submission leaves the pending value intact, so the second submission may be accepted.
The first submission clears the pending value, so the second submission is refused and a new confirmation step is required.
witness.observer: The owner sees whether the original confirmation can still complete the action.

open_points.subject: A13 restatement source reference
open_points.text: `sources/privacy_requirements_20261123.md`, row A4: the owner confirms archiving, erasure and the import
open_points.question: Which indexed requirement is intended by “A4”, or how must this citation be rewritten so its basis resolves without a later reader guessing?
options: Replace A4 with the correct indexed requirement identifier.
Add or index the intended A4 item in the referenced source.
Remove the unresolved row reference and state the accepted requirement directly.
open_points.default_guess: Keep the stated requirement but flag the citation for correction; the supplied text does not identify a resolvable A4 item.

open_points.subject: A21 authorization security-review references
open_points.text: - authorization: APPLICABLE; references: A04, A08, A09, A10, A11, A12; affected: M05, M06, every service operation, every agent-authority operation, owner session actions
open_points.question: Must the authorization category add A13 and A14 as references, as the new review passage says, or are A04 and the existing references intended to cover the missing-confirmation refusal and absence of an audit entry indirectly?
options: Add A13 and A14 to the authorization references so the category names the decisions the new review relies on.
Add A13 only and state that the no-entry guarantee is covered indirectly by an already named decision.
Keep the existing references and explicitly state which named decision supplies both guarantees.
open_points.default_guess: Add A13 and A14, matching the new passage: “Reviewed under authorization (A13 rule 6, A14)”.
